mu_name_from: MuMain _enum.h MONSTER_CHIEF_SKELETON_ARCHER_1 (85), drawn as MODEL_ORC_ARCHER = MODEL_MONSTER01 + 46, so OpenMonsterModel loads Monster47.bmd. WebZen's Monster.txt:113 calls breed 85 'Orc Archer'; MuMain's English client and OpenMU S6 BloodCastle1.cs call it Chief Skeleton Archer. docs/blood-castle-port.md Part B 3.
monster_from: ZzzCharacter.cpp:13453-13466, CreateMonster, case MONSTER_CHIEF_SKELETON_ARCHER_1..8: OpenMonsterModel(MONSTER_MODEL_ORC_ARCHER); CreateCharacter(Key, MODEL_ORC_ARCHER, ...); Scale = 1.1f; Weapon[1].Type = MODEL_BATTLE_BOW, Level = 1. No BlendMesh, no effect.
right_hand_from: MODEL_BATTLE_BOW is MODEL_BOW + 3, Item/Bow04.bmd (cooked). MU sets it in Weapon[1], the bow hand; here it is right_hand, as the Skeleton Archer's, because the cook reads the stance off that field. Its bone is CreateCharacter's weapon switch, case MODEL_ORC_ARCHER: Weapon[0].LinkBone = Weapon[1].LinkBone = 39 (ZzzCharacter.cpp:11970-11973), hand_bofdgne01.
rig_from: Seven actions, exported with --actions=all. 40 bones. BoneHead = 7 (ZzzOpenData.cpp:3718-3723).
sheet_from: The Chief Skeleton Warrior's three sheets, which Monster47.bmd names as Monster48 does: kni00 on the body (512 triangles), kni01 (43), kni02 the helm (54). Shared with Orc01, decoded once as orc_*.
sheet_materials_from: As the Chief Skeleton Warrior's (Orc01), which the user passed: gilt bronze plate kept as painted albedo.
material_overrides_why: As Orc01's: painted_steel's brushed grain striped the plate (the user: 'kind fo striped?'), so it is all but taken out.
sounds_from: ZzzOpenData.cpp:3718-3723: mOrcArcherAttack1 and mBullDie, SetMonsterSound(..., -1, -1, 162, 162, 4) -- no walking cry; 372 ORCARCHERATTACK1 to loose and flinch, 214 BULLDIE to die (offsets from SOUND_MONSTER_BULL1 = 210). Wired as chiefskeletonarcher_* in sounds.json.
islands_from: 12 islands, all painted_steel (see sheet_materials_from). They arrived as skin, the monster profile's default.
plus_from: MU's Level 1 (ZzzCharacter.cpp:13464): the held weapon drawn at its plus, as the Balrog's Bill of Balrog at +9.
